messages:
alex_w: Quick thought — can we tweak the oncall handoff/triage cadence? Current 30m handoffs sometimes leave open incidents with no clear escalation owner.
jamal_r: +1. What's the proposal? shorter handoff or explicit escalation liaisons?
maria_g: I can volunteer as escalation liaison for evenings this week if that helps :+1:
sophie_t: Are we talking daily handoff meeting duration or the structure of the notes/roster? Both could be light changes.
oncall-bot: Active incidents: INC-4723 (high) - ongoing, INC-4730 (medium) - triage in progress. See https://redwood-internal/incidents/INC-4723
alex_w: Proposal: move to 15min structured handoffs + a 1hr weekly triage review. During 15m handoffs we cover: 1) open incidents (owner + next steps) 2) capacity/coverage flags 3) quick rollups for handover. Escalation liaison = someone assigned for next 24h to be point for cross-team escalations.
jamal_r: 15m sounds doable if we enforce an agenda. Maybe roster liaisons for 24h blocks, not shifts, to avoid switching too much.
maria_g: I agree on 24h blocks. I'll take tonight (EST) if someone can note it in the rota.
sophie_t: Can we add a tiny template for the handoff msg? e.g.
```
Handoff: owner: @alice | incident: INC-4723 | status: investigating | next: replicate, rollback plan ready
Escalation liaison: @maria_g
Coverage notes: limited GPU capacity on dedicated pool
```
alex_w: perfect. I'll add the template and an initial rota. Quick poll: who can be escalation liaison tomorrow (UTC dates listed below)? Reply with ok/skip.
oncall-bot: Poll: 2026-03-18 escalation liaison slots open: morning, afternoon, overnight. Vote by replying in thread.
maria_g: ok (overnight)
jamal_r: ok (afternoon)
sophie_t: skip (in meetings most of tomorrow)
alex_w: thanks — I'll update the rota and send calendar invites for the 15m daily handoffs starting Thu 03/18 09:00 UTC. Agenda in the invite: 1) quick incident roll call 2) liaison handoff 3) blockers for next 24h 4) ops flags.
devops-bot: Calendar event created: "Oncall 15m Handoff" Thu 03/18 09:00 UTC -> https://calendar.redwood.internal/event/12345
jamal_r: One more ask: can we include a quick note about preferred fallback models for hosted capacity (e.g., route to smaller quantized variants)? small bullet in coverage notes.
alex_w: good call. adding a line to template: "fallback plan: route -> model-quant-small if latency > 600ms". I'll push the updated template here shortly.
maria_g: thanks — see you at the handoff. :wave:
